flow.intro: Averages per second over the last {sec}s. When "Production" is less than "Usage + Buyback", stock decreases. Buybacked materials mean surplus, while waiting cauldrons mean a shortage of materials. Tap items to view trend charts for the last {window}s.
flow.marketHint: When heat is over 1, customers buy faster than production (stockpiling helps); below 1, there's a surplus (sent to the buyback crate).
flow.stockHint: The vertical axis shows min-max stock over time, so you can spot changes even with large amounts.
flow.netHint: Production − {used} − Buyback. Above 0 means stock is growing; below 0 means it's dropping.
flow.shortHint: Customers whose {name} wasn't ready when they entered and had to wait. Demand adjusts to production so shortages are rare; if this is high, you need more capacity.
flow.starvedHint: The percentage of time cauldrons paused each second waiting for missing materials.
counter.intro: Customers step up to the counter one by one to pay (walking time is fixed). Customers with stock ready will have a coin floating above their head, and {tap} will complete the order as they walk up. Once you buy the Abacus Squirrel, checkouts become automatic! Upgrades shorten checkout time, and at max level, orders complete the moment they arrive. Customers purchase {share} of each potion's output (faster counters and more posters increase this proportion up to {max}%). Order volume follows actual production, and the rest goes to the Buyback Crate. Orders are only fulfilled at full price if complete; if patience runs out and they aren't complete, they buy what's available at ×{partial}% price.
counter.marketTip: Market Heat: A multiplier for customer order volume that changes periodically. When hot, demand exceeds production, so stockpiles are needed to sell everything; when cold, there's surplus production.
crate.title: Buyback Crate Settings
crate.intro: For every potion and material, you can decide whether to {sell} and how much to {keep} (anything over the limit is bought; 0 seconds = buy all). Potions keep "seconds of customer demand": reserved first for full-price customers. When market heat is high, demand exceeds production, so stockpiles are needed to fulfill orders. Materials keep "usage for all cauldrons boiling at full speed for a few seconds": during Rapid Boil or cauldron upgrades, usage spikes suddenly, so keeping a little prevents running out. The buyback price is very low, so selling to customers or brewing into potions is always more profitable.

bond.title: Renown & Bond
bond.renownHow: +1 for every 10x increase in cumulative earnings
bond.hint: Happiness from Little Wishes, resting, headpats, and cheek pokes is multiplied (achievements and gifts are fixed). Rest gives about +{rest} ♥ per hour (offline counts, but diminishes the longer you are away, stopping after {hours} hours); completed {wishes} Little Wishes.
redeem.title: Happiness Exchange
redeem.intro: Only whole numbers are spent. Bond is based on the total Happiness Lumia has ever received, and Happiness spent on redemptions still counts, so redeem freely.
redeem.tier1.title: Lounge Expansion
redeem.tier1.hint: Adds one more display slot to place an extra gift
redeem.tier2.title: Versatile Mascot

redeem.tier3.title: Privilege Talents
redeem.tier3.hint: Permanent upgrades that gold cannot buy

tutorial.pot.title: Tend the Plants
tutorial.pot.body: Tap the pot to help the Heartleaf grow faster. Tap it again once it's ripe to harvest.
tutorial.cauldron.title: Brew Potions
tutorial.cauldron.body: Brewing a Glimmer Tonic takes 2 Heartleaf. If you're short, harvest some from the greenhouse first. Once you have enough, tap the cauldron repeatedly to brew!
tutorial.checkout.title: Help Customers
tutorial.checkout.body: When customers finish shopping, a coin appears above their heads. Tap them to collect the gold.
tutorial.assign.title: Lumia's Work
tutorial.assign.body: Hold and drag Lumia to the greenhouse, cauldron, or counter to have her help in that area. You can also assign her from the Affection menu. Working consumes Stamina, so let her rest when she gets tired!
tutorial.order.title: Cauldron Order
tutorial.order.body: When two cauldrons use the same ingredient, the left one takes it first, and the right one gets the rest.
To prioritize a specific potion, place its cauldron on the left. Press and hold a cauldron in the scene, then drag it over to swap their positions!
book.title: Event Journal
book.intro: Special events occasionally happen in the shop (only while the game is open). Once completed, they are recorded here, and you can tap them for details. Don't worry if you miss one; it will happen again later. For every {every} types collected, and when collecting all of them, income is permanently increased by +{pct}%. Lumia also gets a bit happier the first time you complete each event type.

decor.hint: Drag gifts from the collection below to display them {drag}. They only work when displayed (you can also tap a gift, then tap a slot). Dragging to another slot swaps them, and dragging outside or tapping ✕ puts them away.
decor.bookHint: Buy gifts with gold to give to Lumia. Each can only be given once, and the price won't increase. Giving them raises her Happiness, and you can display them in the lounge afterwards.
